title: Question Mistakes
summary: A wrong question wastes time — it can be vague, leading, or lack measurable signals.

sections.heading: Orientation — Lesson Start
sections.subtitle: Lesson Start
sections.contentMarkdown: - What Will You Understand? A wrong question wastes time — it leads to a lot of data without a decision.
bullets: What Will You Understand? A wrong question wastes time — it leads to a lot of data without a decision.

sections.heading: Core Idea — 3 Mistakes
sections.subtitle: 3 Mistakes
sections.contentMarkdown:
- General ("How is the business?") → Specify: Who? What? When?
- Leading Question ("Why did the ad fail?") → "How many leads?"
- Without Signal ("How many happy customers?") → NPS, repeat purchases.

sections.heading: Quiz
sections.subtitle: Quiz
sections.contentMarkdown:
Quiz:
Leading — assumed the reason for drop-off before seeing the data.
Vague — the question is just general.
No Data — there is no data at all.
Explanation: The correct answer is Leading — it assumes the reason for drop-off before seeing the data.
